prompt:

RIGHT column: on a pure BLACK background, a vertical stack of exactly 8 EQUAL-HEIGHT horizontal CELLS separated by thin grey divider lines, numbered here only for your reference as cell 1 (topmost) through cell 8 (bottommost), reading top to bottom. All 8 cells are currently EMPTY (pure black).
ASSIGNMENT RULE -- POSITION ONLY, no colours or numbers exist anywhere in this image or in this instruction: read the LEFT panel's regions in READING ORDER -- top-to-bottom by row, left-to-right within each row (there are 4 rows of 2 regions each). This reading-order correspondence is the ONLY signal for which shape goes in which cell -- there are no colours, tags, or numbers marking the correspondence anywhere; you must determine each region's rank purely from its row/column position on the panel.
YOUR TASK: for every cell, identify which region on the LEFT panel is ASSIGNED to it (rule below), then paint INSIDE that cell ONLY a single SOLID WHITE FILLED silhouette that matches that region's exact shape and size (same shape family, same proportions), centered in the cell, leaving generous black margin around it. Do this for all 8 cells -- one silhouette per cell, matching all 8 regions. Do not resize, rotate, or distort the shape; do not merge, skip, or duplicate any region. Every silhouette must be plain solid WHITE on black, regardless of the source region's own colour -- the mask column encodes SHAPE and CELL ASSIGNMENT only, never colour.
Do not alter the LEFT panel's regions in any way (same shapes, same positions, same neutral fill). ABSOLUTELY NO TEXT, NO WORDS, NO LETTERS anywhere in either column.
Do NOT print any numbers, digits, tick-marks, or labels anywhere in either column -- neither on the panel nor in the mask cells.
